            "expression": "x6 + x7 + x8 + x9 + x10 = 3",
            "description": "Instrument beta has exactly 3 observation slots available in the scheduling window."

            "expression": "x2 * x7 = 0 (equivalently x2 + x7 <= 1)",
            "description": "T2 (Abell 2029 lensing) and T7 (GW follow-up S231010a) both require the facility's sole adaptive optics system for their respective instruments during the same time window. At most one can be observed."

                "x1x4": 20,
                "x1x5": 20,
                "x2x3": 20,
                "x2x4": 20,
                "x2x5": 20,
                "x3x4": 20,
                "x3x5": 20,
                "x4x5": 20
